title: Al-Infitar 82:5-8 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Al-Infitar, ghunnah and the sifat in practice
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 32 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Infitar 82:5-8 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 32. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ (٥) يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ (٦) ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ (٧) فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ (٨)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Infitar 82:5-8 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 82:5-8 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 82:5-8 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Find the two madd munfasil in 82:6 and 82:8.
Link 82:7 to science: name one way the human body is balanced.
questions.a: For example: two eyes for depth, the inner ear for balance, bones and muscles working in pairs.
A) proportioned you and balanced you. 82:7: 'Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?'

questions.q: Al-Infitar 82:6: «يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: 'What has deceived you about your Lord, the Generous?' (82:6). What things make people forget Allah?
questions.a: Busyness, wealth, games and screens; Allah's generosity should make us more thankful, not careless.
